q: The Veech dichotomy for translation surfaces (flat surfaces with conical singularities) states that for a Veech surface, every direction θ is either:
opts: Completely ergodic and minimal in direction θ, or has all flow lines closed (periodic direction)
exp: Veech dichotomy: for a Veech surface (one with a large group of affine symmetries, the Veech group), every direction is either (1) a saddle connection direction (all trajectories periodic, i.e., the surface decomposes into cylinders) or (2) ergodic and minimal (the directional flow is minimal and uniquely ergodic).
